# VIP GECE External Proof Templates

Bu dosya taslak alandir. Buradaki icerik `npm run full-goal-readiness` tarafindan proof sayilmaz.

Gercek kanit geldikten sonra ilgili sablonu `docs/external/<proof-name>.md` yoluna kopyala ve placeholder alanlarini temizle.

## Production Deploy - `docs/external/production-deploy-vip-gece.md`

```md
# VIP GECE Production Deploy Proof

- Date:
- Production URL: https://vip-gece.com
- Deployed package SHA:
- Traffic switch method:
- Live SEO command: npm run live-seo-audit -- --strict
- Live SEO result:
- Owner confirmation:

No secrets included.
```
